THE GUARD (fc-guard.mjs; no kernel in it). A blend only changes material inside the cross-section triangle spanned by the edge and two legs of length size along the two faces it joins. R1 that triangle lies inside both faces (no other boundary edge of a face closer than size: hole rim, pocket rim, an earlier chamfer edge; the face's own neighbours at both ends reach at least size; size equal to the extent is refused too); R2 nothing of another face inside the triangle; R3 no curved third face at an end point (an earlier fillet or a cylinder boss); R4 the edge is not one piece of an edge a pocket or hole cut in two; cylinder rims: size clear of the radius by max(0.1, 0.5 percent of R) and of the side height, no other cap edge in the annulus; size >= 0.01 (whole shape and edge level alike); R5 (groups) two group edges on one face that do not touch need a face wider than twice the size between them WHEN THE FACE LIES BETWEEN THEM (even-odd test of the midpoint of their nearest points against the face's outer loop and holes; the opposite edges of a pocket opening do not count, their strips point away from each other: the first version of R5 had no side test and refused 4 of 56 correct pocket rims in fuzz seed 5303, fixed and re-run); R6 the same edge twice in one group is refused; R7 three or more chamfers at one corner are refused (corner convention differs from OCCT, brep-rs and FreeCAD); R8 (new in round 4, guardShellRim) hollow() of a face whose edge carries a FILLET of at least the wall is refused (knife-edge rim; the pane builds it silently). guardPrimitiveRound: roundStyle chamfer of a box, size below 0.01, zero and negative sizes. postCheck: a blend of ONE straight planar edge must add exactly one face (fired on 0 guarded single-blend builds that were otherwise accepted).
